STURDY HIGH-CARBON STEEL FRAME DESIGNED FOR WOMEN

STURDY HIGH-CARBON STEEL FRAME DESIGNED FOR WOMEN
Crafted from premium high-carbon steel, this women’s mountain bike frame delivers excellent durability, stability, and long-lasting performance. Designed with a geometry tailored for female riders, it ensures a more comfortable and controlled riding posture for both city commuting and light off-road use.

SAFE & RELIABLE DOUBLE DISC BRAKE SYSTEM

Equipped with front and rear mechanical disc brakes, providing strong and consistent stopping power in all weather conditions. Ride with confidence on asphalt roads, gravel paths, or forest trails, with enhanced safety and precise braking control.

OPTIMAL 26" WHEELS FOR STABILITY & CONTROL

The 26-inch wheels offer a perfect balance of maneuverability and stability, making them especially suitable for smaller riders. Enjoy smooth handling and confident control across urban streets and outdoor terrains.

COMFORTABLE RIDING WITH FRONT SUSPENSION FORK

The responsive suspension fork effectively absorbs shocks and vibrations from uneven surfaces, reducing impact on the rider. This ensures a smoother, quieter, and more comfortable riding experience on rough roads and trails.

IDEAL FOR DAILY COMMUTING & LEISURE RIDES

Perfect for everyday use, weekend rides, and outdoor adventures. Whether commuting to work or exploring countryside trails, this women’s mountain bike combines practicality, comfort, and stylish design for versatile performance.

Gamille is a bike specially designed for females in the Gamille series by Hiland. This series focuses on off-road mountain bikes for beginners. From its overall size to frame design to the special top tube, all designs are more attuned to the needs of women and youth. The bright paint is highly eye-catching to fall in love at the first sight. High-quality professional configuration makes it easy to handle all road conditions in mountains, dirt roads and commuting, which brings you diversified riding enjoyment. Whether for exploring adventures or daily commuting, Gamille 3.0 is the ideal choice.
